title: Installing Python

spans.text: Install Python with the official installer for your operating system from python.org. Windows provides the Python Launcher; macOS and Linux may use a versioned Python 3 command. Reopen the terminal and verify the version after installation.

spans.code: Version strings vary by installed Python and pip.

spans.text: Check the version with Python's --version command.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: If several Python versions are installed, verify which interpreter a project actually uses.

spans.title: Important detail
spans.text: The executable may be named python3 or py, depending on the platform.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
